notes.notes:
- NCS Library: 1200+ copyright-free songs!
- Ignore Damage in editor levels
- Hide Level Complete screen
- Back to last checkpoint after Practice Complete

- Mac: Fixed launch and performance issues

notes.title: Update 2.204
notes.notes:
Update 2.204 Patch notes

- Added borderless windowed mode.
- Added extra orb frame.
- Added optional player hitbox view.
- Decreased platformer air slide.
- Bugfixes and tweaks.

/RubRub

notes.title: Update 2.203
notes.notes:
Update 2.203 Patch Notes

• Reverted to default friction while in air. New friction still on ground.
• Fixed ice-block sliding.
• Added in-depth Demon display on profile.
• Added some editor tools: individual object scaling, half grid movement, and falling events.
• Added fast menu (decreases transitions between pages).
• Fixed several bugs.

/RubRub

notes.title: Update 2.201
notes.notes:
- Changed Platformer default sliding.
- Added more Platformer sliding options.
- Added coyote time when jumping off platforms in Platformer.
- Added Practice mode to Platformer.
- Added option to see hitboxes in Practice mode.
- Changed how profile statistics are displayed.
- Lowered the prices on many of the new items.
- Lots of bugfixes.

/RubRub

notes.title: Geometry Dash update seven years in the making smashes Steam records
notes.notes:
Almost seven years after its last major update, Geometry Dash 2.2 has released, seeing the game have an astronomical spike in players on Steam and hit a new concurrent player peak, as loads of free levels, modes, and more arrive for the music platforming game. Players are coming back in droves to Geometry Dash, making it feel like 2013 all over again.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Steam's Hidden Gems: 10 brilliant games you've almost certainly missed

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.notes:
Update 2.2 is here!

- New level "Dash"
- New game mode: Swing
- New game type: Platformer
- 4 new Platformer levels
- New collectable: Moons
- Over 700 new icons
- Over 100 new achievements
- Add sound effects to levels with SFX Library
- New Music Library
- 9999 groups
- Shader Effects
- Particle Editor
- Camera Controls
- Keyframe and Auto-Build system
- Gradient, Area, Rotate Gameplay, Scale, Random, and over 80 other new triggers
- Lots of editor improvements: Increased scaling, layer locking, color hex inputs, trigger precision, and more
- Lots of new art, such as over 1500 pixel blocks
- Lots of new animations
- Create lists of levels
- Over 30 new Gauntlets
- Set FPS freely
- New shops and chests
- New shards
- Secrets...
and much more!

/RubRub

notes.title: Update 2.2 Info and Trailer
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Unfortunately, 2.2 will not be coming in October as promised and is delayed to November. It just wouldn't feel right to release an update this big without stable servers and proper bugfixing. I tried my hardest to make it in time, but some work took longer than expected. 

All I can do is apologize and do my best in these final weeks. I'm really looking forward to sharing all these new features with the community. 

Despite the delay, the update is still very close, which is why we have made a final release trailer. Check it out!

/RubRub

notes.title: Update 2.01
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 2.01 is now available on Steam and will be available on iOS, Google Play, Amazon and Windows Phone in a few days. Apple will have to wait for the review time, but shouldn't take more than a week.

The update fixes a lot of the bugs from 2.0, and should also improve performance. Hopefully levels with a lot of moving objects won't lag as much :)

The update also includes a stat recount system that will recount all stars, demons and collected user coins. There was a bug in 2.0 that gave users extra stars/coins, this fixes and resets that problem.

The stat recount will also remove stars gained from cheats/bugs/exploits. So if you lose stats when the update comes out, you will know why
smile emoticon

Hopefully the system should be more stable now and the leaderboards should slowly become more cheat-free :)

New mappacks are in the works and should be done in a few days!

Thanks everyone for your awesome support! I will upload the first update 2.1 promo in a day or two :D

/RubRub

notes.title: Update 2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://boomlings.com/images/20screen3.png[/img]

Could it be?...

Finally! Update 2.0 is the BIGGEST update ever for Geometry Dash! It will be releasing on all platforms and should be available within a few hours. Amazon/Windows Phone may take a little longer.

- New level "Geometrical Dominator"
- New Demon level "Deadlocked"
- Robot gamemode
- Moving objects
- Teleportation portals
- User coin system
- User profile pages
- Friend and messaging systems
- Friend leaderboards
- Over 50 new achievements and rewards
- Lots and lots of new art
- Animated monsters and level objects
- Drastically improved save and load times
- Editor preview mode
- Lots of editor improvements
- Unlimited color channels
- Lots of bug fixes
- Secrets...
- and more!

Thank you for playing Geometry Dash! Since this is a very big update, there are probably a few sneaky bugs that I have missed. Please contact support@robtopgames.com for help with any issues.

/RubRub

notes.title: Update 1.92
notes.notes:
Update 1.92

- Added ability to manually set music offset in the options
- Better windowed performance on some systems
- Added option to "delete all downloaded songs"
- Practice mode flag buttons no longer clickable if mouse is invisible
- Minor bugfixes and tweaks

This was just a quick maintenance update. Will keep releasing these as I iron out the bugs. Content update 2.0 is still in the works, lots of cool new stuff coming there.

/RobTop
